title: commiphora edulis subsp. boiviniana
intro: Commiphora edulis subsp. boiviniana, commonly known as African myrrh, is a plant species of the genus Commiphora, which is a type of shrub or small tree native to Africa. The health benefits of African myrrh include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antifungal properties, which can help to treat various conditions such as wounds, skin infections, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of African myrrh include its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce pain and inflammation, and promote wound healing, making it a popular ingredient in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of African myrrh include sesquiterpene, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
